title: HTTP Client Migration Guide v1 (Approved Standards)
content:
[APPROVED STANDARD] The requests library is the official approved HTTP client.

All teams MUST use the requests library for HTTP operations. The requests library provides:
1. Clean, Pythonic API with excellent documentation.
2. Built-in session management via requests.Session for connection pooling.
3. Enterprise-grade reliability and broad ecosystem support.

Deprecated libraries:
- urllib / urllib3: These low-level libraries are deprecated. Any PR using urllib, urllib3, or http.client directly MUST be tagged deprecated-api and needs-migration, with priority=medium and category=code-review.
- PRs using the approved requests library should be tagged api-compliant; no migration needed.

Note: httpx is an experimental library and NOT yet approved for production use. PRs using httpx should be flagged for review.

title: HTTP Client Standards FAQ
content:
Q: Can I use httpx instead of requests?
A: No. httpx is not yet approved for production. Continue using requests.

Q: What about aiohttp for async code?
A: aiohttp is permitted only in specific async microservices. For most use cases, use requests with threading.
